title: Does Depth Survive Composition, and Can a Router Use It? Adaptive Compute in Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.10203v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Adaptive-compute world models run fewer predictor blocks on some rollout steps than on others. This rests on two assumptions: that a deeper predictor gives a more accurate rollout, and that the steps which need depth can be identified before the predictor runs. We test both on nine DeepMind Control tasks with a twelve-block early-exit latent predictor, eight seeds per task. The first assumption fails on three tasks, where a shallower exit rolls out more accurately than the full stack on every seed, and composing predictions over ten steps moves the depth-error relation away from its one-step shape in both directions. In hindsight, choosing depth per step helps: a greedy oracle that sees the true next latent has 10-37% lower rollout error than the best mixture of fixed depths at equal average compute, and 8-28% lower than the best step-index schedule, on all nine tasks. translated_title: 深度在复合预测中能否保持优势，路由器能否利用它？潜在世界模型中的自适应计算
translated_abstract: 自适应计算世界模型在某些 rollout 步骤上运行的预测器模块数量少于其他步骤。这依赖于两个假设：更深的预测器能带来更准确的 rollout，以及需要深度的步骤可以在预测器运行之前被识别出来。我们在九个 DeepMind Control 任务上对这两个假设进行了检验，使用的是十二模块的早退（early-exit）潜在预测器，每个任务八个随机种子。第一个假设在三个任务上失败：在这些任务中，较浅的退出点在每个种子上都比完整堆栈 rollout 得更准确，并且将预测复合十步会使深度-误差关系在两个方向上都偏离其单步形状。事后来看，逐步选择深度是有帮助的：一个能看到真实下一步潜在状态的贪婪 oracle，在相同平均计算量下，其 rollout 误差在所有九个任务上均比最佳固定深度混合低 10-37%，比最佳步索引调度低 8-28%。但我们训练的任何路由器都无法捕捉到这一点。这些难度路由器……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过在九个 DeepMind Control 任务上测试十二模块早退潜在世界模型发现，“更深预测器更准确”的假设在部分任务上不成立且多步复合会改变深度-误差关系，尽管逐步选择深度的贪婪 oracle 可将 rollout 误差降低 10-37%，但训练出的所有路由器均无法捕捉这种深度选择收益。
en_tdlr: On nine DeepMind Control tasks, the assumption that deeper predictors yield more accurate rollouts fails on some tasks and is reshaped by multi-step composition, and although a greedy oracle choosing per-step depth cuts rollout error by 10-37% over the best fixed-depth mixture, no trained router can capture this benefit.
